jq.name: one web researcher uses all three direct tools and no authored inference config
jq.expr: (.config.agents | length) == 1 and .config.agents[0].agent_id == "web-researcher" and .config.agents[0].inference_profile_id == "gents:inference-slot:web_researcher" and ([.config.tools[].integrations.plugins[].plugin] | sort) == ["gents/web_crawl", "gents/web_fetch", "gents/web_search"] and ([.manifest.inference_slots[].name] == ["web_researcher"]) and (.manifest.plugins | map(.name) | sort) == ["web_crawl", "web_fetch", "web_search"]

jq.name: the three model tool schemas close inputs and reject legacy-only controls
jq.expr: (plugin("web_search").input_schema | .additionalProperties == false and .required == ["query"] and (.properties | keys == ["deadline_ms","intent","max_results","query","query_variants"]) and .properties.max_results.minimum == 1 and .properties.max_results.maximum == 12 and (.properties.intent.enum == ["auto","web","code","paper","news","entity"])) and (plugin("web_fetch").input_schema | .additionalProperties == false and .required == ["url"] and (.properties | keys == ["deadline_ms","focus","links","max_chars","media","mode","must_contain","offset","section","selector","toc","url"]) and (.properties.url.anyOf[1].minItems == 1 and .properties.url.anyOf[1].maxItems == 12) and .properties.max_chars.minimum == 200 and (.properties.mode.enum == ["scan","read","deep"]) and (.properties | (has("handles") | not) and (has("actions") | not) and (has("stitch") | not) and (has("image_text") | not) and (has("since_last") | not) and (has("budget_tokens") | not))) and (plugin("web_crawl").input_schema | .additionalProperties == false and .required == ["url"] and (.properties.mode.enum == ["full","map","content"]) and .properties.same_host.const == true and .properties.map_limit.maximum == 1000 and .properties.per_page_max.minimum == 200 and .properties.max_total_chars.minimum == 1 and (.properties | (has("resume") | not) and (has("since_last") | not) and (has("dataset") | not) and (has("include_paths") | not) and (has("exclude_paths") | not)))

jq.name: each plugin has only host-mediated HTTP authority and a ten-second request timeout
jq.expr: .manifest.plugins | length == 3 and all(.[]; .manifold.fs == "None" and .manifold.net.OutboundHttp == null and .manifold.env == "None" and .manifold.crypto == false and .manifold.child_process == false and .manifold.http_timeout_ms == 10000)

jq.name: the web researcher prompt tells the agent how to cite and handle untrusted pages
jq.expr: .assets["agent_behaviors/web_researcher/system_prompt.md"] | contains("web_search") and contains("web_fetch") and contains("web_crawl") and contains("untrusted source material") and contains("links")
